description: Get one company's profile from a domain (such as stripe.com) or a name (such as Stripe): what it is (description, industries, website, logo, Wikipedia page), where it sits (headquarters, country), how big and old it is (employees with the date, founded), its stock tickers and social accounts, from Wikidata; its legal entity (legal name, LEI, legal and head office address, status) and its direct and ultimate parent company, from GLEIF; and the domain's registration date and registrar, from RDAP. A name can match several items: other_matches lists them, so send the domain for a sure match. A source that fails is named in data.items[0].errors while the others still answer. No person is named. Costs 1 credit. Every row has name (platform/collection/id), kind, its fields and source {platform, url, license, attribution, fetched_at, terms_url}; quote source.attribution when you show a row.

domain.description: The company's domain, such as stripe.com (a URL or work email also works).

name.description: The company's name, such as Stripe or Siemens AG; used when no domain is sent.

name: data_company_profile
title: Get a company profile
